memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: So when the people broke camp to cross the Jordan, the priests carrying the ark of the covenant went ahead of them. Now the Jordan is at flood stage all during harvest. Yet as soon as the priests who carried the ark reached the Jordan and their feet touched the water's edge, the water from upstream stopped flowing. It piled up in a heap a great distance away, at a town called Adam in the vicinity of Zarethan, while the water flowing down to the Sea of the Arabah (that is, the Dead Sea) was completely cut off. — Josh 3:14-16 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
And there it is — the miracle. Notice the detail Scripture gives us: the Jordan was at flood stage. This was the hardest possible time to cross, the river swollen and dangerous. God did not wait for an easy season to act. He often shows His power precisely when the situation looks most impossible, so that no one can claim it was anything but Him.

The turning point is unmistakable: "as soon as the priests... their feet touched the water's edge, the water... stopped flowing." Not before. The moment of obedience was the moment of the miracle. The priests had to get their feet wet before the river gave way. Faith took the step, and God did the rest.

Picture the wonder of it — the water piling up in a heap far upstream, the riverbed drying before their eyes. What looked utterly impossible one moment became a highway the next, all because God is faithful to His word.

This is a lesson for every believer standing before a swollen, impossible-looking obstacle. Our God specialises in flood-stage situations. The same power that stopped the Jordan is at work for us in Christ, who through the cross and resurrection opened a way where there was no way (Eph 3:20). When the river is at its highest, He is still able.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are you facing a "flood-stage" situation that seems impossible?
2. Do you believe God can act most powerfully when things look worst?
3. What step of obedience is God waiting for before He makes a way?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You are the God of flood-stage impossibilities. When the river before me is at its highest, help me step out in faith and watch You make a way. Amen.
